layers.authority: Vanuatu Tourism Office listing for Millennium Cave Tours (Espiritu Santo)
layers.process: Millennium Cave is visited on a booked tour with one guide for roughly every two guests; the tour starts in Funaspef village and the listing says proceeds support the village school and community. The day is 4 to 6 hours of trekking, caving, canyoning and river floating, described as challenging. Torches, life jackets and flotation aids are provided, and transport from Luganville is included. No separate site fee or price is stated on the tourism office page.

sources.title: Millennium Cave Tours
sources.supports: guided tour, guide ratio, village proceeds

zone-requirements.note: The landowner and any separate village access fee are not named on the page; ask the operator.
